newsitem.title: USA: Republic Industries to acquire car group.
newsitem.headline: Republic Industries to acquire car group.

text.p: Republic Industries Inc said Monday it had signed a definitive agreement to acquire the Dobbs Automotive Group of Memphis, Tenn., for $200 million in common stock.

Republic said in a statement that the group had been described as the seventh largest dealer group in the U.S., with dealerships in Tennessee, Alabama, North Carolina, South Carolina, Florida and Arizona.
It said the acquisition will include all related real estate.

Republic said it had entered into long-term employment agreements with John Shanks, the group's chief executive officer, and Frank Grese, it's chief operating officer, to allow them to continue managing the dealerships.
"Republic expects to enter into long-term employment agreements with the rest of the senior management team of Dobbs Automotive Group and the other employees with the dealerships," it said.
Republic's stock was off 6/16 at 23-1/16 in early Monday trading on the New York Stock Exchange.

Republic is a diversified holding company with subsidiaries operating in the automotive retailing, automotive rental, automotive financial services, solid waste services and electronic security services industries.
